newsitem.title: UK: Lasmo squeezed higher after results.
newsitem.headline: Lasmo squeezed higher after results.

text.p: Shares in Lasmo Plc climbed 10-1/2 pence to 279 with some analysts saying this was due to a short squeeze, while others pointed to the company's upbeat comments on its medium-term outlook.
Lasmo, which earlier reported a first-half profit increase at the lower end of analysts' expectations, said it saw a strong production increase in the next four years.
The company expects output to climb to 250,000 barrels per day from a current level of 171,000 barrels.
"It's the first time they gave us an explicit target," said Irene Himona at SocGen.
She added she was also impressed by Lasmo's target to bring its costs down to six pounds per barrel from over seven pounds now.
But another analyst, who declined to be named, said the results and accompanying statement contained no major surprises.
"There are some encouraging signs there, but there is nothing to merit this share price rise," he said.
Lasmo's net profit before exceptional items rose to 26 million stg from 24 million stg. Analysts had predicted a figure within a range of 24 to 32 million stg.
